description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a single endpoint for updating an item. It includes a Pydantic data model for the item, specifying various fields and constraints, and a route handler that accepts an annotated request body.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with fields for name, description, price, and optional tax, including validation constraints.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Annotated[Item, Body(embed=True)])
methods.description: A route handler for updating an item, accepting an item ID and item data, returning a dictionary containing these details.

ctags.name: price
ctags.pattern: /^    price: float = Field(gt=0, description="The price must be greater than zero")$/

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Annotated[Item, Body(embed=True)]):$/
